svg.title: Request state before the packed step
svg.desc: Request A has 16 tokens in the KV cache from earlier steps and computes A16 now, so its sequence length is 17. Request B is new and computes both prompt tokens. Request C prefilled C0 to C13 in an earlier step and computes C14 to C16 now, so its length is also 17.
svg.text: Before this step · what each request already has in the KV cache
token Xn = token at position n of request X · positions count from 0
prompt and earlier outputs, computed in earlier steps · A16 was sampled last step
new request · its whole 2-token prompt runs now
long prompt · an earlier step prefilled the first chunk, this step the next 3 tokens
only the orange tokens enter this step: A16 · B0 B1 · C14 C15 C16
the cached tokens are not computed again · attention reads their KV from the cache
